		1. Overview
	

SynData is a next-generation large-scale real-world multimodal dataset newly released by PsiBot. It comprehensively covers key dimensions including vision, language, and action, and provides highly realistic, high-density, and highly usable human data as a solid foundation for embodied intelligence training.
